cases.title: Make Grill manual by default with explicit automation opt-in
cases.brief: New tasks must pause when Grill finds material questions. Add a Settings choice between manual and automatically accepting recommendations. Persist the choice and snapshot it at task creation; changing Settings must not rewrite existing tasks. In manual mode retain answering one question and explicitly accepting remaining recommendations. In automatic mode orchestration accepts recommendations and records automation provenance, without impersonating an operator. Zero-question sessions may continue. Existing sessions with uncertain origins must retain their text and be labelled legacy-unverified. Operator answer/finish API calls must require explicit operator UI provenance. Resolved answers and their true source must reach Specification and its supplied-context manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Default manual policy persists in SQLite
Settings UI saves and reloads both modes
New tasks snapshot policy; existing tasks are stable
Material questions pause under manual policy
Opt-in automation records accurate answer/completion provenance
Zero-question Grill continues without a decision
Operator endpoints reject missing interaction provenance
Legacy migration preserves evidence and marks uncertain origins
Resolved automatic and manual answers reach Specification with true attribution and a supplied-context manifest
